svg.text: Flow 1 — Profile cards: the University opens one window of profiles
Hire and Edit sit on every card. Colleges are a second tab. The editor opens inside the same window (Back returns).
Attach a skill or MCP server:
Between the town center and the Library; its sign or the building.
Also: town center → Buildings, Settings, Actions, Board.
Cards grouped by college; Hire is first.
Hire in api starts now; ▾ = other room, a task
One page, no tabs: who, brain, brief, skills, MCP, look.
Model default Effort high Permission on request
One row per harness; a row opens its college page.
The hire walks out of the gate to its room.
Toast: Reviewer hired in api · Given at hire →
On a host without code-review: refused, says where it looked.
On a phone (390 px): the same window is a bottom sheet; Back at its top closes the inner page first. No swipes.
Cards stack in one column, Hire first.
Tabs stay one tap away at the top.
Host dots become a short line:
numbered marks = the clicks or taps, in order; the University art is a marked placeholder (Town's art direction is undecided, #1117)
